title: Differentiation of human embryonic stem cells into keratinocytes
author: Liu, Huang, et al.
materials: This section details procedures for reagent preparation, including reconstitution, aliquoting, and storage of compounds required for culture and differentiation media. Briefly centrifuge lyophilized powders to ensure complete collection. Aliquot the stock solutions into single-use volumes. Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.11.Dissolve retinoic acid (RA) powder in DMSO to prepare a 20 mM stock solution. Aliquot the RA stock solution and store at −80°C. Keep a single working aliquot at −20°C for up to 1 month.CRITICAL: RA is light-sensitive. All procedures including dissolution, usage, and storage should be performed under light-protected conditions to ensure compound stability.12.Dissolve Epidermal Growth Factor (EGF) and basic Fibroblast Growth Factor (bFGF) powders separately in sterile distilled water to prepare 100 μg/mL stock solutions.CRITICAL: Maintain EGF and bFGF stock solutions at ≥50 μg/mL concentration to ensure stability.13.Prepare stock solutions by dissolving Keratinocyte Growth Factor (KGF) and ROCK inhibitor Y27632 powders in sterile distilled water. The final stock concentrations should be 50 μg/mL for KGF and 100 mM for Y27632, respectively.
Materials associated with this protocol are available upon request from the lead contact.

steps.title: Prepare Matrigel coating
steps.instruction: Thaw Corning Matrigel hESC‑qualified Matrix at 4 °C for 24 h, pre‑chill 1.5 mL tubes and tips, aliquot according to lot‑specific dilution factor, dilute one aliquot in 25 mL cold DMEM/F‑12, coat plates with 1 mL/well (6‑well) or 0.5 mL/well (12‑well), incubate 37 °C ≥60 min (do not exceed 48 h), store coated plates at 4 °C up to 1 week sealed with Parafilm.

steps.title: Prepare collagen coating
steps.instruction: Pre‑chill 50 mL tubes, dilute type I collagen 1:49 in ice‑cold PBS, coat plates with 1 mL/well (6‑well) or 0.5 mL/well (12‑well), incubate 37 °C ≥60 min (max 48 h), store coated plates at 4 °C up to 1 week sealed with Parafilm.

steps.title: Reconstitute stock solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve retinoic acid (RA) powder in DMSO to 20 mM, aliquot, store at –80 °C; keep one working aliquot at –20 °C (light‑protected, up to 1 month). Dissolve EGF and bFGF powders separately in sterile distilled water to 100 µg/mL (maintain ≥50 µg/mL). Dissolve KGF in sterile water to 50 µg/mL and Y27632 to 100 mM. Aliquot all stocks as single‑use volumes and avoid repeat freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Prepare culture media
steps.instruction: a) mTeSR1 complete: thaw 5× supplement at 4 °C 24 h, add to basal medium, mix, aliquot, store –80 °C ≤6 months; keep working aliquot at 4 °C ≤2 weeks. b) SE differentiation medium: add RA to mTeSR1 complete to 1 µM, store dark at 4 °C ≤2 weeks. c) Keratinocyte induction medium: thaw DKSFM supplement at 15‑25 °C, add to DKSFM basal, add EGF and bFGF each to 10 ng/mL, store dark at 4 °C. d) Keratinocyte growth medium: add KGF to 10 ng/mL and Y27632 to 10 µM to complete DKSFM, store dark at 4 °C. e) Terminal differentiation medium: add 1 M CaCl₂ stock to growth medium to reach 1.2 mM final, store dark at 4 °C.

steps.title: Thaw and plate hESCs
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm mTeSR1 complete and DMEM/F‑12 to 15‑25 °C. Coat a 6‑well plate with Matrigel (see step 1). Retrieve frozen hESC vial, thaw in 37 °C water bath ~3 min (≈90 % thawed). Transfer to 50 mL tube, slowly add 10 mL pre‑warmed DMEM/F‑12 (no pipetting up/down). Centrifuge 280 g 5 min at 25 °C, aspirate supernatant. Resuspend pellet in 1 mL pre‑warmed mTeSR1, pipette up/down once with P1000. Aspirate matrix from coated plate, add 2 mL/well pre‑warmed mTeSR1, seed at 1:15‑1:20 passage ratio (~300‑400 colonies/cm²). Gently shake for even distribution, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Replace medium daily; passage every 4‑5 days at 50‑60 % confluence. If attachment is poor at 24 h, supplement medium with 10 µM Y27632 for the first 24 h.

steps.title: Seed hESCs for SE differentiation
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm mTeSR1 and DMEM/F‑12 to 15‑25 °C. Coat 12‑well plates with Matrigel (step 1). Aspirate medium from the 6‑well hESC culture, wash once with 1 mL DMEM/F‑12, aspirate. Add 1 mL Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent, incubate 37 °C 3 min, aspirate. Add 1 mL pre‑warmed mTeSR1, scrape colonies gently, pipette 3‑4 times with P1000 (avoid single‑cell suspension). Aspirate matrix from coated 12‑well plates, add 1 mL pre‑warmed mTeSR1 to each well. Seed at 1:30 passage ratio (~100‑200 colonies/cm²). Gently shake, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 24 h.

steps.title: Differentiate hESCs to SE
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm SE differentiation medium to 15‑25 °C (do not use 37 °C water bath). Aspirate medium from the 12‑well plate, add 1 mL/well SE differentiation medium. Incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, monitor morphology daily. Replace medium every 48 h. Harvest cells on day 7 for immunostaining and qRT‑PCR (use 2‑3 wells per assay). Proceed only if ≥80 % KRT18⁺/TP63⁺ cells are obtained.

steps.title: Induce keratinocyte progenitors
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm keratinocyte induction medium to 15‑25 °C. Aspirate SE differentiation medium completely from the 12‑well plates. Add 1 mL/well induction medium. Incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Replace induction medium daily. Culture for 45 days; assess progenitor markers (KRT14, TP63, ITGB4, LAMB3, COL7A1) at day 45.

steps.title: Passage and expand progenitors
steps.instruction: Coat 12‑well plates with type I collagen (step 2). Pre‑warm keratinocyte growth medium. Pre‑warm 0.25 % trypsin‑EDTA at 37 °C ≥15 min. Aspirate induction medium, wash cells twice with 1 mL PBS (no Ca/Mg), aspirate. Add 500 µL 37 °C trypsin‑EDTA, incubate 37 °C 3‑5 min until detachment begins. Pipette 5‑10 times to obtain a single‑cell suspension. Add 500 µL defined trypsin inhibitor (DTI) to neutralize. Transfer to 15 mL tube, centrifuge 280 g 5 min at 25 °C, aspirate supernatant. Resuspend pellet in 1 mL pre‑warmed growth medium, count cells. Aspirate collagen from coated plates, add 1 mL pre‑warmed growth medium. Seed 5 × 10⁴ cells per well, shake cross‑shaped for even distribution. Incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; monitor daily and passage or cryopreserve at 90‑95 % confluence.

steps.title: Induce terminal differentiation
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm keratinocyte terminal differentiation medium to 15‑25 °C (ensure final CaCl₂ 1.2 mM). Aspirate growth medium from confluent progenitor cultures. Add 1 mL terminal differentiation medium per well. Incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Replace medium daily. Culture for 7 days; assess KRT1, KRT10, FLG, LOR, TGM1 expression.

steps.title: Air‑lifting culture assay
steps.instruction: Coat 24‑well transwell inserts (0.4 µm polyester) with 200 µL type I collagen (step 2). Pre‑warm keratinocyte induction medium to 15‑25 °C and 0.25 % trypsin‑EDTA to 37 °C ≥15 min. Aspirate growth medium from 12‑well plates containing expanded progenitors, wash twice with 1 mL PBS (no Ca/Mg), aspirate. Add 500 µL 37 °C trypsin‑EDTA, incubate 37 °C 5 min, pipette 5‑10 times, add 500 µL DTI, transfer to 15 mL tube, centrifuge 280 g 5 min at 25 °C, aspirate supernatant. Resuspend pellet in 1 mL pre‑warmed induction medium, count cells. Aspirate collagen from transwell inserts, seed 7 × 10⁵ cells per insert, add 200 µL induction medium to the insert and 500 µL to the lower chamber of the 24‑well plate. Incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 3‑5 days, replacing medium in both compartments daily. After this period, aspirate medium from the upper inserts and adjust lower‑chamber volume to 200 µL to create an air‑liquid interface. Maintain at the interface 7‑10 days, then fix with 10 % neutral‑buffered formalin for downstream histology and immunofluorescence.
